g.text: Fixed head edits: the first mentioned value matches the fact
Left three formats share 1,024 item keys; attribute QA uses a separate 1,024-item cohort. Greedy generation, at most 16 new tokens.
Paired 95% prompt-cluster bootstrap intervals. Gray ×: two norm-matched controls per channel. Each edit is compared with its own reference.
Attribute QA changes both questions and content items; this is not a paired wording-only comparison.
